h-b-specialties.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 3 H&B Specialties locations, 2 in Illinois and 1 in Missouri. The Illinois bids come from Granite City and Meredosia, and the Missouri bid comes from Cape Girardeau. The table carries corn and soybeans at each spot the network reads.

heartland-co-op.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 53 Heartland Co-op locations, all of them in Iowa. The towns run from Alleman and Booneville to Brooklyn, Cambridge, Carlisle and Colo. The table carries corn and soybeans at each spot, so that is what it holds.

heritage-coop.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 16 Heritage Coop locations, all of them in Ohio. Towns on the list include Ada, Arlington, Cairo, De Graff, Fletcher and Kenton. The table carries bids for corn, soybeans and wheat at each spot.

hi-plains-coop.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 8 Hi-Plains Coop locations, all of them in Kansas. Towns on the list include Brewster, Dresden, Gem, Hoxie, Mc Donald and Park. The table carries bids for corn, soybeans and wheat, so it covers the usual crops out that way.

hoven-equity-exchange.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 3 Hoven Equity Exchange locations, all of them in South Dakota. The towns include Aberdeen, Ipswich and Onida. The table carries corn and soybeans at each spot the AGSIST network reads.
